Where little learners are known by name

A small, caring preschool on Isiolo Road, Nairobi. Few children per class, Christian values every week, and a lot of play, skating and singing along the way.

Book a school visitChat on WhatsAppCall 0714 840 418

No child is left behind

Because our classes are small, teachers know each child's strengths, fears and favourite games. Parents describe St. Jude as a school with love, personalised care and inclusivity at its heart, and a strong foundation for everything that comes after.

Small classes

More attention for every child.

Inclusive

Every child belongs here.

Clean and safe

Good sanitation, praised by parents.

Accessible

Step-free entrance and parking.

How children learn here

A solid curriculum

A well-planned programme that builds early reading, number and language skills.

Co-curricular activities

Skating, play and creative sessions that build confidence and coordination.

Christian virtues

Weekly lessons on kindness, honesty and respect that shape character.

Talent nurturing

We notice what each child loves and give it room to grow.

A day at St. Jude

Roller skating, with helmets, pads and a coach beside them, is one of the extra activities children look forward to.

A typical day

Exact times may vary by class. Ask us for the current timetable.

MorningWelcome, circle time and a short prayer or devotion
Mid-morningLearning time: letters, numbers, language and creative work
BreakSnack, handwashing and free play outdoors
Late morningStories, songs, and co-curricular activities such as skating
Home timeTidy up, goodbyes and a short note to parents

How to join

  1. Contact usCall or message us on WhatsApp.

  3. RegisterFill in the admission form for your child.
  4. Settle inWe help your child feel at home from the first day.

Questions parents ask

What ages do you take?

We are a preschool for young children. Message us your child's age and we will tell you which class fits.

How many children are in a class?

Classes are kept small so every child gets personal attention.

What are the fees?

Fees depend on the class. Call or WhatsApp us for the current fee structure.

Is the school accessible?

Yes. We have a wheelchair-accessible entrance and car park, and gender-neutral toilets.

Where are you?

On Isiolo Road, Nairobi (plus code RW3R+W2 Nairobi).
